w: Fishtown taproom in a refurbished auto shop under the El (opened 2017) — locals' pick in Northeast Times' 2026 best-taproom roundup, a Billy Penn and Inquirer regular for its gimmick-free-for-all beers, fire pits and cornhole patio.
dish: Key-lime-margarita sours and stunt-named IPAs on the patio

w: Barrel-lined whiskey bar on the Fishtown/Kensington line — the Infatuation's pick for unusual bourbon and rye (a five-pour PA whiskey flight), on Philly Mag's best-bars-in-Fishtown list.
dish: Flight of five Pennsylvania-made whiskeys

w: Fishtown's bottle-shop-bar hybrid: a wall of ~700 craft beers, six taps, pool and darts — on Philly Mag's best Fishtown bars list and Hop Culture's best Philly bottle shops.
dish: ~700 bottles and cans to drink in or take out

w: Greg Vernick's Emilia-Romagna-inspired trattoria (opened Jan 2026) — Craig LaBan called it "phenomenal" (Inquirer, Apr 2026), added to the Eater 38 in the summer 2026 update.
dish: Capellini in pesto; wood-grilled seasonal plates and house focaccia

w: Port Richmond bakery since 1924, five generations on — its pound cake bar is the Polish-neighbourhood holiday staple the Inquirer keeps returning to (Easter rush, best pound cakes) and PhillyVoice calls a must.
dish: The 2½-lb pound-cake "bar" (secret 1940s recipe)

w: Brewerytown's go-to sandwich-and-bottle-shop (moved into its bigger Girard Ave home in 2023) — on Philly Mag's Brewerytown bars & restaurants guide; Inquirer covered it from opening.
dish: Kansas City pulled-pork sandwich with a craft-beer bottle from the shop wall

w: Restaurant-bar with a 6,500-sq-ft indoor/outdoor dog park in the old North Star Bar on the Fairmount/Brewerytown edge — reviewed by Philly Mag (2024), covered by the Inquirer and Billy Penn.
dish: Hot-honey Brussels sprouts and a buffalo chicken sandwich while the dog runs the indoor park

w: Chestnut Hill's long-running Chinese-French dining room (15+ years on Germantown Ave) — on Philly Mag's Chestnut Hill restaurant guide, reviewed by the Infatuation and Time Out as the go-to for families and big groups.
dish: "Chinese kissed by French" — Peking-style duck and family-style platters

w: Manayunk sports-bar-meets-neighbourhood-restaurant whose burger both the Infatuation (Manayunk guide) and Philly Mag/Foobooz (best restaurants in Manayunk) single out.
dish: The Bar Jawn burger

w: Love City's second brewpub, opened on Main Street in the old Fat Lady space (Inquirer, PhillyVoice 2026) — on the Infatuation's and Philly Mag's Manayunk guides for its beer-and-BBQ menu.
dish: House IPAs and lagers with a long BBQ menu

w: Spruce Hill's corner craft-beer institution (44th & Spruce) with its own bottle shop next door — in Time Out Philadelphia, Philly Mag and the Inquirer's best-bottle-shops roundup.
dish: Craft drafts with the cheeseburger (or vegan wings) and a bottle-shop to-go

w: Cedar Park's Black-owned Southern brunch-and-whiskey anchor on Baltimore Ave (opened 2017, new owners 2023 with the Bayou Lounge) — written up by Craig LaBan and on Visit Philly's Baltimore Avenue dining guide.
dish: Chicken and waffles, blackened catfish and a deep American-whiskey shelf

w: Baltimore Ave Ethiopian café named for the coffee ceremony it keeps alive — reviewed by Craig LaBan (Inquirer, 2021) and the Infatuation, who single out its weekend brunch.
dish: Weekend buna (coffee) ceremony from a jabena with injera-spiced eggs and crispy whole fish

w: Chef Kris Serviss's corner sandwich shop — on the Infatuation's 20 best spots in Northeast Philly and Northeast Times' roundups for its inventive sandwiches.
dish: General Tso's chicken cheesesteak; pork-belly Reuben

w: Massive Cantonese dim-sum hall that opens at 9:30am daily — the Infatuation's Northeast Philly dim sum pick, also in Northeast Times' coverage.
dish: Cart-style dim sum from 9:30am; lobster with minced pork

w: "To many people from Northeast Philadelphia, Gaeta's is tomato pie" (Inquirer) — a 1930s Germantown recipe now baked in Rhawnhurst; on the Infatuation, Billy Penn's where-to-eat-tomato-pie and Philly Mag's Northeast guide.
dish: Sheet-pan tomato pie with caramelised edges (cash, takeout)

w: Somerton teahouse-style Uzbek-Russian kitchen — Philly Mag's Northeast guide calls its soups, kebabs and vareniki superb; on Visit Philadelphia's Northeast dining guide.
dish: Veal kebabs and cherry/cheese/potato vareniki

w: Castor Avenue Jamaican counter — Philly Mag's Northeast guide and Visit Philadelphia's Northeast round-up both send you for the jerk chicken and curry goat.
dish: Jerk chicken over rice and peas; curry goat; patties

w: Korean BYOB on Lancaster Ave — on the Inquirer's 2025 Ardmore best-restaurants map and Philly Mag's piece on the Main Line's diversifying dining scene.
dish: Korean fried chicken wings, mandoo and LA galbi

w: ~100-seat East Kensington agave bar from NYC hospitality veterans Jeff Bell and Victor Lopez (opened Aug 2026 in the old Martha space) — on the Inquirer's August 2026 openings and Eater Philly's September 2026 heatmap.
dish: Handmade tortillas, ceviche and family-style pork al pastor with a deep tequila/mezcal list

w: Point Breeze Vietnamese bar-restaurant from Victor Nguyen and Anna Huynh cooking the dishes they grew up on — on the Inquirer's 2026 openings and Eater Philly's September 2026 heatmap.
dish: Pho and bánh xèo with 24 local beers on tap

w: Ellen Yin's (High Street Hospitality; James Beard Outstanding Restaurateur) 30-seat Milan-style all-day aperitivo bar in Rittenhouse — featured by the Inquirer (Aug 2026) and Eater Philly's September 2026 heatmap.
dish: Morning espresso and pastries; evening spritzes and cicchetti

w: Family-run Chinatown café pairing Taiwanese-Chinese dumplings and beef noodle soup with siphon coffee — the Infatuation calls its coffee and tea the best in the neighbourhood; on Visit Philly's Chinatown guide.
dish: Dumpling sampler with siphon coffee or rare Taiwanese tea

w: Chinatown Sichuan dining room — the Infatuation's long-lunch pick and on Visit Philly's best Chinatown restaurants list.
dish: Sichuan dan dan noodles and dry-pot dishes (strong vegetarian menu)

w: Philly outpost of NYC's century-old Doyers St dim sum parlour — the Infatuation's budget dim sum pick in Chinatown and on Visit Philly's Chinatown guide.
dish: Old-school dim sum: shrimp har gow, roast-pork buns, egg rolls

w: Pottstown craft distillery's tasting room on the Avenue — on Philly Mag's where-to-drink-in-East-Passyunk list; Billy Penn's what-to-drink guide.
dish: Apple-brandy Sidecar; four-grain-whiskey Sazerac

w: Tapas-and-wine bar on East Passyunk's fountain stretch — Philly Mag's where-to-drink-in-East-Passyunk pick, reviewed by Time Out Philadelphia.
dish: Tapas with a 20-page Spanish-led wine list (Txakoli, Canary Islands rosé)

w: The dive that invented Philly's "Citywide Special", home of the city's longest-running drag show (Thursdays) and no-cover live jazz — Inquirer, WHYY and Visit Philly regular, a Best of Philly winner.
dish: The Citywide Special — a Jim Beam shot and a PBR — invented here

w: Point Breeze corner bar (John Longacre & chef Scott Schroeder) with a patio, sixteen taps and its namesake sardine sandwich — reviewed by the Inquirer, on the Infatuation's Point Breeze picks.
dish: The $2 sardine sandwich with egg and onion; 16 rotating craft taps

address: 300 W Mt Pleasant Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19119
w: West Mt Airy neighbourhood gastropub (opened 2019) — on the Infatuation's Mt Airy & Germantown guide for its crab cake sandwich; Chestnut Hill Local covered its 19-tap opening.
dish: Crab-cake sandwich with one of 20+ local drafts

w: Germantown cider tasting room with a firepit patio near Cliveden and the Johnson House (opened 2020) — covered by the Inquirer's Philly cider story and NBC10's Mt Airy Restaurant Week picks.
dish: Hard ciders from Pennsylvania apples with hand pies and sourdough soft pretzels

w: Family-run Caribbean bakery at 2nd & Tioga that Puerto Rican, Dominican and Cuban Philadelphians cross the city for — on Visit Philly's El Centro de Oro dining guide and profiled by Temple's Philadelphia Neighborhoods newsroom.
dish: Pastelitos de guayaba and pan sobao
